questions.question: When Samson lit torches tied to the tails of foxes to strike back at the Philistines, where did he send the foxes?

answers.text: Into the hill country of Judah

questions.question: After the Philistines burned Samson's wife and her father to death, Samson said he would not rest until he had taken vengeance on them. True or false?
After Samson broke free from his bonds at Lehi, what did he pick up to strike down a thousand Philistines?

answers.text: The fresh jawbone of a donkey
